summary_ja: この告示は令和五年三月三十一日から適用する。一部は令和六年三月三十一日から適用する。
summary_en: Applies from March 31, 2023; certain provisions apply from March 31, 2024.
paragraphs: This Public Notice applies from March 31, 2023; provided, however, that the amending provision revising Articles 23 through 25 of the Supplementary Provisions and paragraph (2) of the following Article apply from March 31, 2024.
